verdict.rationale: Filee's llms.txt and GitHub README name input→output pairs category by category, so a power user can check most pairs before trying one. Examples: PDF to images/Word/HWPX/PowerPoint/text/comic archive; DWG/DXF to each other or to PDF/SVG/PNG; 3D, font, subtitle, data and audio formats into each other; SVG to DXF/DWG; multi-step routes like HWP→HWPX→DOCX found automatically. Missing for 10: a single consolidated conversion matrix or CLI command to list supported pairs, precise coverage where docs say "and more" or "many more" (ebooks, archives, photo inputs), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented pairs match actual behavior.
